mcp.description: Read-only invoice data service. Use it only to discover and retrieve invoice records from the Invoice entity.

Invoice.description: A denormalized invoice record containing invoice facts and the customer and sales representative details captured with the record.

fields.name: InvoiceId
fields.description: Unique numeric identifier for the invoice.

fields.name: CustomerId
fields.description: Identifier of the customer billed by this invoice.

fields.name: CustomerName
fields.description: Name of the customer or organization billed by this invoice.

fields.name: SalesRepId
fields.description: Identifier of the sales representative assigned to this invoice.

fields.name: SalesRepName
fields.description: Full name of the sales representative assigned to this invoice.

fields.name: SalesRepRegion
fields.description: Region assigned to the sales representative.

fields.name: InvoiceDate
fields.description: Date and time when the invoice was issued.

fields.name: DueDate
fields.description: Date and time when payment is due.

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: Total invoice amount in the currency specified by Currency; stored as a decimal value.

fields.name: Currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code for Amount, for example USD, EUR, or GBP.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Current payment lifecycle status, such as Paid, Pending, Overdue, Draft, Cancelled, Approved, or Rejected.

fields.name: PaymentMethod
fields.description: Payment method used or expected for the invoice, such as Credit Card, Bank Transfer, Wire Transfer, or ACH.
